Package geometries

Class Geometries

java.lang.Object
geometries.Intersectable
geometries.Geometries
public class Geometries extends Intersectable
The Geometries class represents a collection of Intersectable objects, such as spheres, planes, triangles, etc. It serves as a composite design pattern, allowing the management and intersection calculations of a group of geometries.

This class provides methods to add geometries to the collection and to find intersection points of a given Ray with all the geometries in the collection.

  • Constructor Details

    • Geometries

      public Geometries()
      Constructs an empty Geometries object.

      Initializes the internal list of geometries to an empty list, allowing geometries to be added later using the add(Intersectable...) method.

    • Geometries

      public Geometries(Intersectable... geometries)
      Constructs a Geometries object and adds the given Intersectable geometries to it.

      This constructor allows initializing the collection with one or more geometries.

      Parameters:
      geometries - one or more Intersectable objects to add to the collection. If no geometries are provided, the collection will remain empty.

  • Method Details

    • add

      public void add(Intersectable... geometries)
      Adds one or more Intersectable geometries to the current collection.

      This method allows adding multiple geometries at once using varargs. Each geometry passed as an argument will be added to the internal list of geometries managed by this object.

      Parameters:
      geometries - one or more Intersectable objects to be added. Can pass zero or more geometries.

    • calculateIntersectionsHelper

      public List<Intersectable.Intersection> calculateIntersectionsHelper(Ray ray)
      Finds the intersections of a ray with all geometries in the collection.

      This method iterates through all the geometries in the collection and calculates the intersection points of the given Ray with each geometry. If there are no intersections, the method returns null.

      Overrides:
      calculateIntersectionsHelper in class Intersectable
      Parameters:
      ray - the Ray to find intersections with.
      Returns:
      a list of intersection points, or null if no intersections are found.
